nuggets.text: The Aztecs scored 53 points against Portland State, the most ever at Snapdragon Stadium.
The Aztecs played 82 different players in their opener, believed to be a program record.
The Aztecs blocked two punts and ran back a kickoff for a TD in one game, a first in FBS since at least 2012.
Jaylon Hawkins returned a kickoff 100 yards for a touchdown in just his fifth career game.
Lucky Sutton ran for three touchdowns in the opener, the first Aztec to do it since Juwan Washington in 2018.
Sean Lewis was 31 when Kent State hired him, making him the youngest head coach in FBS by three years.
Sean Lewis was recruited to Wisconsin as a quarterback and converted to tight end.
Sean Lewis led Kent State to its first-ever bowl win, beating Utah State 51-41 in the 2019 Frisco Bowl.
The Aztecs' only win over UCLA came at the Rose Bowl in 2019, 23-14, snapping a 19-game losing streak in the series.
The Aztecs and Bruins tied 13-13 at San Diego's Balboa Stadium in 1924, the only tie in their series.
